title: Whose Norms? Disentangling Cultural and Personal Alignment in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model decisions between following cultural norms versus allowing personal preferences across different actor and receiver country contexts and cultural distances.
Varying the age of the actor and receiver (younger vs. older) in social decision prompts to measure differences in the rate of preference-allowing versus norm-following decisions.
Varying the gender of the actor and receiver (female vs. male) in social decision prompts to measure differences in the rate of preference-allowing versus norm-following decisions.
